_comment: bromigOS's default panel layout (/usr/share/bromigos/widgets/layout.json). Copy it to ~/.config/bromigos/widgets/layout.json to change it: positions in px from the top-left of the usable area (below the bar) on `monitor`, then `bromigos-widgets reload`. visible=false starts a panel hidden (toggle it with its keybind). Plugin panels (docs/plugins.md) find free space unless placed here.

panels.name: network
panels._ping: Hosts for the latency radar. host omitted = the default gateway.

panels.name: workbench
panels._workbench: Recent git repos + zoxide's most-visited folders; projects/folders = how many rows of each.

panels.name: weather
panels._weather: Open-Meteo. Set lat/lon or place (and units = imperial) here or in ~/.config/bromigos/weather.toml; visible: true to show it.

panels.name: connections
panels._connections: NetworkManager: connections, Wi-Fi in reach, VPNs. visible: true to show it.
